Mono.Cecil 0.11.6, official .NET Framework 4.0 binary
Source/lib/Mono.Cecil.dll, MIT license.
Source: https://github.com/jbevain/cecil/tree/0.11.6
Package: https://api.nuget.org/v3-flatcontainer/mono.cecil/0.11.6/mono.cecil.0.11.6.nupkg
License text: Mono.Cecil-LICENSE.txt

The classic release includes a patched assembly for the 2015 original game and
OriMotionSmoothing.dll built from classic/Source. Source-controlled build scripts
apply the scoped changes to the user's original game assembly for reproducibility.
The game and its assets belong to their respective rights holders.
